title: Knotted periodic orbits in dynamical systems—I: Lorenz's equations
note: Topology 22(1) (1983), 47-82. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1016/0040-9383(83)90045-9) (2026-11-28). Introduces branched 2-manifold templates (knot-holders) by quotienting stable foliations of 3-dimensional hyperbolic/semiflow sets, proving periodic orbits project isotopically to positive-braid template knots (Sections 2-4).
